info.name: CreatorIQ - Module 1
info.description: Run the whole collection with the Collection Runner (top to bottom). Start the backend first. Demo users must exist.

exec: pm.test("role is creator and no password is returned", function () { var j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.role).to.eql("creator"); pm.expect(j).to.not.have.property("password_hash"); });

item.name: Register - try to sign up as admin

exec: pm.test("422 admin role is not allowed at signup", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(422); });
pm.test("token returned", function () { var j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.access_token).to.be.a("string"); pm.collectionVariables.set("new_token", j.access_token); });
pm.test("401 Unauthorized (same as wrong password)", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(401); });
pm.test("401 with invalid token", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(401); });
pm.test("role is creator", function () { var j = pm.response.json(); pm.collectionVariables.set("creator_token", j.access_token); });
pm.test("role is agency", function () { var j = pm.response.json(); pm.collectionVariables.set("agency_token", j.access_token); });
pm.test("role is marketing", function () { var j = pm.response.json(); pm.collectionVariables.set("marketing_token", j.access_token); });
pm.test("role is admin", function () { var j = pm.response.json(); pm.collectionVariables.set("admin_token", j.access_token); });

item.name: Creator tries to promote self to admin

exec: pm.test("200 OK (agency manages this creator)", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test("403 (creator not managed by this agency)", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(403); });
pm.test("has at least one creator", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().length).to.be.at.least(1); });
pm.test("401 old password rejected", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(401); });
pm.test("401 token no longer works", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(401); });
